mcp_tools.name: mcp_server_design_and_review
mcp_tools.title: MCP server design and review
mcp_tools.description: Submits an MCP server design record (tool design and budget, transports and auth, safety rails and injection awareness, versioning contract tests and observability, red lines) and returns a deterministic MCP_SERVER_SOUND / MCP_SERVER_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including computed per-tool schema, single-job, operation and destructive-gate checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record; it connects to no server.

inputSchema.description: The mcp server design and review manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

tools.description: Declared tools: {name, operation, has_typed_schema, single_job, has_negative_test, approval_or_scope_gate_present}.

expect.notes: All boolean flags set to pass; computed_spot_checks: tools_count=1, typed_schema_coverage=1.000000
